name: Calendar
author: tmn73
description: Your calendar in the bar: Google, iCloud, any CalDAV server or an iCal feed. Your day at a glance, one click to join a meeting, and events you create and edit without leaving the desktop.

barWidget.description: Your calendar in the bar: Google, iCloud, any CalDAV server or an iCal feed. Your day at a glance, one click to join a meeting, and events you create and edit without leaving the desktop.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: auto follows the system locale (Portuguese for pt_*, otherwise English).

schema.label: Desktop reminders
schema.description: Notify at each event's reminder times; meetings with a link get one 10 minutes before.

schema.label: Announce events (minutes before)
schema.description: Show the next event beside the clock this long before it starts. 0 keeps the clock alone.

schema.label: Announced title length
schema.description: Longest title the bar announces, in characters; longer ones end in an ellipsis. Lower it when the announcement runs into the widgets beside it.

schema.label: Click
schema.description: What a click on the clock does: panel opens the panel, join opens the current or next meeting, format cycles the clock format.

schema.label: Middle click
schema.description: What a middle click on the clock does, with the same choices as click.

schema.label: Right click
schema.description: What a right click on the clock does, with the same choices as click.

schema.label: During an event
schema.description: untilEnd keeps "Now" on until the event ends. firstMinutes shows it for the first 2 minutes.

schema.label: Next event during one
schema.description: announce shows the next event once it is due. keep stays on the current event until it ends.
